newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq expresses surprise at UN comments on weapons.
newsitem.headline: Iraq expresses surprise at UN comments on weapons.

text.p: Iraq said on Wednesday it was surprised at remarks by a senior weapons inspector that its disclosures on past weapons programmes were incomplete.

The Iraqi News Agency quoted Oil Minister Lieutenant-General Amir Muhammad Rasheed as saying remarks by UN Special Commission (UNSCOM) Deputy Chairman Charles Duelfer contradicted his own comments in meetings with Iraqi officials.
"What Duelfer said...about Iraq's announcements on its past weapons programmes contradict what he said in his meeting with us and lack objectivity," the agency quoted Rasheed as saying.
"Rasheed said these announcements were detailed, complete and comprehensive, according to previous remarks by UNSCOM experts during tens of visits they undertook," INA said.
Duelfer told Reuters on Tuesday that Iraq's disclosures in August on its chemical, biological and missile capabilities contained "problems of errors and omission".
He held talks with Rasheed, a former head of Iraq's Military Industrialization Commission, early on Wednesday.
After the 1990-91 Gulf conflict, the United Nations was given the task of depriving Iraq of its weapons of mass destruction.
